say:0:1029203001:0.text: Who are you? An accomplice of that maniac?
say:0:1029203001:0.source_cn: 嗯？你又是从哪来的……莫非是那个战斗狂的同伙？
say:0:1029203001:0.male: Who are you? An accomplice of that maniac?
say:0:1029203001:0.female: Who are you? An accomplice of that maniac?

say:1:1029203002:0.text: Couldn't beat that Mauler fursack, but I bet I can take you!
say:1:1029203002:0.source_cn: 好不容易等到那个蛮血战斗狂走了……我打不过他，难道还打...
say:1:1029203002:0.male: Couldn't beat that Mauler fursack, but I bet I can take you!
say:1:1029203002:0.female: Couldn't beat that Mauler fursack, but I bet I can take you!

say:2:1029203003:0.text: Defeat this man, and we'll leave together!
say:2:1029203003:0.source_cn: 打倒这个人，我们也一起离开！
say:2:1029203003:0.male: Defeat this man, and we'll leave together!
say:2:1029203003:0.female: Defeat this lady, and we'll leave together!
